product.title: Kauai Waimea Canyon, Wailua River Boat and Fern Grotto Tour

description.text: Experience the natural wonders of Kauai on this full-day guided tour, featuring a scenic Wailua River cruise to the lush Fern Grotto and breathtaking views of Waimea Canyon. Visit iconic spots like Opaekaa Falls and the Kauai Coffee Estate, where you can sample locally grown coffee. Stops include Wailua River, Fern Grotto, Waimea Canyon, Opaekaa Falls, Kauai Coffee Estate. With a knowledgeable guide, air-conditioned transport, and plenty of photo stops, this tour offers a perfect blend of relaxation, history, and stunning landscapes. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
